item.title: TTT 412: Arts And Crafts
item.description: Eric and Rachelle host Calgary’s only podcast. In this episode, Rachelle is here to answer your advice questions. However, since we forgot to ask you for them so she goes over some Dear Abby questions that Eric found. Also, we show how to give us a good iTunes review. It’s very easy. You should try it. We continue with a recap of Eurovision 2015 song from Latvia, Italy, and Hungary.
